services.name: Jersey Devil Kids Fishing Fall Camp
services.desc: Ahoy Parents, ⚓️ We’re excited to announce something brand new at Jersey Devil Kids Camp—our Fall Fishing Session! After an amazing 2025 season, we’re keeping the adventure going with smaller, weekend camps designed to give kids even more time on the water. Below are the important details to help you prepare: 🐟 Age Requirement All campers must be 10 years or older to attend. Fall Session Schedule & Options Days Offered: Saturdays & Sundays (you can choose one or both days) Time: 8 AM – 12 PM Location: Fair Haven Dock (End of Fair Haven Road) 👉 Small group format: minimum of 4 kids, maximum of 6 kids per day, ensuring every camper gets hands-on instruction and a personalized experience.
